text: Recent visitor reviews indicate issues with the museum’s use of AI in exhibits, with some guests feeling the experience lacked educational value and was not accessible to taller visitors. Several reviewers noted poor lighting and insufficient signage, which made navigation difficult and detracted from the visit. The timed entry system caused confusion, with advice emerging that arriving after the scheduled time can reduce wait times. Food service also received negative comments regarding quality and speed. Despite these concerns, the overall rating remains high, and many visitors appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture.

On the positive side, several visitors appreciated the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture. Overall, the average rating remains above 4.5 despite these criticisms.
